<!-- Generated by npm run docs:gen. Do not edit. Edit examples in site/src/content/examples/mcp/add_entry.md. -->

Add a journal entry. Pass `project` explicitly whenever you know it, and pass `cwd` so that gournal can record the repo and branch. The server process's own working directory is not a reliable signal for which project the calling agent is actually in. Fields come from the explicit arguments first, then from `cwd`, then from the first client root, and last from the server's own cwd (only when `project` is omitted).

## Input

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `summary` | `string` | no | One line, max 120 characters. Put longer text in `details`. |
| `message` | `string` | no | Deprecated alias for summary. Use summary instead. |
| `details` | `string` | no | Longer text for this entry. Use it when the summary needs more room. |
| `kind` | `"done" \| "blocker" \| "next"` | no | Entry kind: done (default), blocker (something stops you), or next (a planned step). Default: `"done"`. |
| `project` | `string` | no | Project name for this entry. Pass it explicitly. Do not rely on the server working directory. |
| `repo` | `string` | no | Repository name, for example owner/name. |
| `branch` | `string` | no | Git branch name. |
| `cwd` | `string` | no | Your working directory. Gournal derives project, repo, and branch from it. |
| `agent` | `string` | no | Name of the calling agent. Gournal stores it with the entry. |
| `tags` | `string[]` | no | Tags for this entry. Reuse existing tags (list_tags). |
| `refs` | `object[]` | no | References such as PRs and ticket keys. Put them here, not in tags. |
| `refs.type` | `"pr" \| "jira" \| "commit" \| "url"` | yes | Kind of reference: a PR, a Jira key, a commit, or a URL. |
| `refs.value` | `string` | yes | The PR number, ticket key, commit hash, or URL. |
| `refs.repo` | `string` | no | Repository (owner/name) of the PR or commit. |
| `resolves` | `string[]` | no | Ids of open blocker or next entries that this entry closes. Use the full id or the last 8 characters. |

## Output

This tool returns structured output. The shape is the [Entry result](/gournal/docs/reference/mcp/output-shapes/#entry-result).

## Examples

Log a finished piece of work. Pass `project` and `cwd`.

```json
{
  "summary": "Fix rounding error in invoice totals",
  "details": "Totals were off by one cent when a discount applied after tax.",
  "project": "billing-api",
  "cwd": "/Users/you/dev/billing-api",
  "tags": [
    "bugfix",
    "invoices"
  ],
  "refs": [
    {
      "type": "pr",
      "value": "412",
      "repo": "acme/billing-api"
    }
  ]
}
```

The text result:

```text
Entry YDZR73PK added to billing-api: Fix rounding error in invoice totals
```

The structured result:

```json
{
  "entry": {
    "id": "01M7FRCQ8GYQH7Z6X9YDZR73PK",
```
